LanguageData.JJ_SortieAttackDesc: Zoom into the map below and choose an unroofed square for an explosive strafing run. The preview shows a west-to-east line of impacts centered on your target. Friendly units can be hit. The aircraft remains airborne and continues burning fuel.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieLandDesc: Choose a landing location on the sortie map. This ends the sortie and cancels any pending strafing run. Use the normal launch command to travel or land elsewhere.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieUnavailable: The aircraft is no longer flying this sortie.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieEnRoute: The aircraft must reach the sortie map first.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieNoMap: The sortie map is no longer available. Choose another destination with the launch command.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieLandingCooldown: This map is temporarily closed to arrivals.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieNeedsPilot: A capable pilot must occupy the pilot seat.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieRearming: The aircraft is completing its pass or preparing for another run.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieInvalidTarget: Choose a visible, unroofed square on the sortie map.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieLowFuel: {0} is low on fuel. Order a landing or return flight now; remaining airborne will exhaust its fuel and cause a crash.
LanguageData.JJ_SortieMapGone: {0}'s sortie map is no longer available. The aircraft will continue circling and using fuel until you choose another destination.
